text_sections.label: Effect
text_sections.text:
You can include up to 50 copies of cards with this card's card number in your deck.
When you would play this card from your hand, reduce its play cost by 2 if you don't have another [ADR-02 Searcher] in play.
[Your Turn] This Digimon can't attack players.
[On Play]＜Draw 1＞ (Draw 1 card from your deck.)

text_sections.label: Inherited Effect
text_sections.text: [Your Turn] All of your Digimon with [D-Reaper] in their traits get +1000 DP.
